Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing regular meetings of county legislative authorities to be held at alternate locations within the county.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing regular meetings of countylegislative authorities to be held at alternate locations within thecounty; and amending RCW 36.32.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.32.080 and 1989 c 16 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided otherwise by this section, the countylegislative authority of each county shall hold regular meetings at thecounty seat to transact any business required or permitted by law. (2) Regular meetings may be held on an occasional basis at alocation outside of the county seat but within the county if the countylegislative authority determines that holding a meeting at an alternatelocation would be in the interest of supporting greater citizenengagement in local government.
